nodes.name: .fallowrc.json
nodes.summary: Fallow dead-code analysis configuration that sets source entry points (src/index, src/main), duplicate-detection thresholds (minOccurrences 3), a warn rule for unused dependencies, and per-file ignoreExports lists for Svelte components and game-data constants that fallow would otherwise flag.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent Context file describing the voxlblade-builder project: the Svelte 5 + Vite + TypeScript stack, source layout, development workflow (install/dev/test/build/lint/format), testing conventions, and AI agent interaction guidelines.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Stock create-vite README for the Svelte + TypeScript template, covering recommended IDE setup, why plain Vite was chosen over SvelteKit, and technical decisions around global.d.ts, allowJs, and HMR state preservation.

nodes.name: build-decode.txt
nodes.summary: Two-line scratch artifact holding a corrupted/truncated JSON snapshot of a decoded in-game build (race ORK, class Monk, weapons, runes, and essence parts) used as a manual decode scratchpad.

nodes.name: build-decode2.json
nodes.summary: Invalid/truncated JSON file (1 line) containing the same corrupted decoded build snapshot as build-decode.txt; not machine-parseable, kept as a working artifact.
nodes.languageNotes: Contents are truncated and not valid JSON (parse fails); kept as a scratch artifact.

nodes.name: fallow-output.json
nodes.summary: Fallow dead-code analysis report (schema v7) recording 28 total issues: 1 unused file, 23 unused exports, 2 unused types, and 2 duplicate exports, with entry-point sources and guided next-step fallow commands.

nodes.name: fallow-security.json
nodes.summary: Fallow security analysis report with security_findings (e.g. a low-severity tainted-sink / CWE-79 finding in src/DidYouMean.svelte writing to innerHTML), an attack-surface summary, and unresolved-callee diagnostics.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML entry page for the VoxlBlade Builder app: loads Font Awesome from CDN and mounts the Svelte application by loading /src/main.ts into the #app container.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Project manifest for voxlblade with scripts (dev, build, preview, check, test) and dependencies including Svelte 5, Vite 8, TypeScript 6, Vitest, fallow, Playwright, vite-plugin-pwa, rollup-plugin-visualizer, and @vercel/analytics.

nodes.name: stats-data.json
nodes.summary: Single-line rollup-plugin-visualizer output tree (JSON) of the production bundle, enumerating rolldown/vite runtime chunks, Svelte internal modules, and app modules with per-module sizes and UIDs.
nodes.languageNotes: Entire file is one minified JSON line; parseable by the visualizer tooling.

nodes.name: stats.html
nodes.summary: Self-contained Rollup Visualizer report (≈4950 lines) with embedded chart-rendering JavaScript and an inline bundle module tree; it redraws the treemap on window resize and DOMContentLoaded.

nodes.name: ts-errors.txt
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder file (0 non-empty lines) apparently intended to capture TypeScript compiler error output; currently contains no diagnostics.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the Svelte app extending @tsconfig/svelte, targeting ES2023 with svelte and vite/client types, checkJs enabled, and src/**/*.{ts,js,svelte} included for svelte-check.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript config that simply extends ./tsconfig.app.json so editor tooling picks up the app typechecking settings.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for the Node/build side covering vite.config.ts with bundler module resolution, node types, noEmit, and strict linting flags (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters).

nodes.name: vercel.json
nodes.summary: Vercel deployment configuration that runs npm run build, serves the dist output as a Vite app, and sets immutable long-term Cache-Control headers for /assets, plus must-revalidate policies for /sw.js and /index.html.
